items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my grandmother, who we used to call “Fat Mama,” it was Mama and Fat Mama, and it finally ended up being “Fatsie,” what a beautiful woman she was.

ctx.x: Mama was a choir singer in the 19th Street Baptist Church and her mother, my grandmother, who we used to call “Fat Mama,” it was Mama and Fat Mama, and it finally ended up being “Fatsie,” what a beautiful woman she was. She was part Choctaw.
